title: Social Media and Depression Symptoms: A Network Perspective
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subjects network
limitations: - Student sample (non-clinical); - Low mean levels of depression symptoms; - Potential recall bias; - Data may not meet multivariate normality assumptions; - No formal centrality tests; - Limited to linear relationships; - No logistic regression for bimodal distributions
notes: The study was not preregistered. Code and data are available in the online supplementary materials. The authors note that the between-subjects partial correlations were calculated differently than the default mlVAR method to address implausible correlations.
